reason: My bank's already linked to my budgeting app, so my spending tracks itself without me photographing anything. And for grocery lists and due dates I've got Notion and my notes app for free, so $6 a month for this is a hard no on my income.
objection: Taking a picture of every receipt is more work than what I do now, not less. 'No bank login' sounds like a selling point, but for me it means doing the tracking by hand again.
would_change_my_mind: If the syllabus photo really dropped every due date for the semester into my calendar, I might use the free tier for that. I still wouldn't pay unless it replaced the budgeting app I already have.
